categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the development, construction, operation, and management of hydropower and new energy projects, including wind and solar power. It operates as the largest clean power operator in the Lancang-Mekong sub-region, focusing on hydropower resources in the Lancang River basin and surrounding areas. The company also actively develops integrated water, wind, solar, and energy storage projects to support sustainable energy development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced hydropower technologies including intelligent dam construction and smart hydropower plant management systems. It has completed core control system upgrades and developed fully domestically produced control systems. The company emphasizes digital and AI-driven platforms for integrated management and operation, and pursues R&D in high-altitude dam construction, reservoir safety monitoring, and multi-energy complementary systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include regional power grids such as Yunnan Electric Power Grid and other provincial grids in China, as well as electricity consumers in China’s southwestern regions and neighboring countries like Myanmar and Cambodia. The company serves the electricity market primarily through direct sales of hydropower and renewable energy, supporting national strategies like 'West-to-East Power Transmission' and regional clean energy supply.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in southwestern China, especially Yunnan Province, Sichuan Province, and Tibet Autonomous Region, with hydropower stations also in Myanmar and Cambodia. It has subsidiaries and projects distributed across these regions and maintains international operations in Southeast Asia. The company’s geographic focus is on the Lancang River basin and adjacent areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power supply chain, focusing on power generation and electricity sales. It develops and manages hydropower and renewable energy assets, sells electricity directly to grid operators and end users, and engages in power marketing and trading activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes integrated development of hydropower and new energy, accelerating multi-energy complementary bases. It focuses on digital transformation, AI applications, and smart plant construction. R&D efforts target dam safety, intelligent construction, and energy storage integration, with ongoing national and regional technology projects. The company also emphasizes reform, governance, and innovation to build a world-class modern green power enterprise.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electricity produced by hydropower, wind power, and solar photovoltaic projects. The company also earns income from power trading services, government subsidies, and investment returns from equity holdings. Direct sales to regional power grids constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading hydropower operator in the Lancang-Mekong sub-region and a core enterprise in Yunnan’s clean energy sector. It holds a dominant position in the regional hydropower market, with competitive advantages in integrated basin development and multi-energy complementary dispatch. Competitors include other regional hydropower and renewable energy producers, but the company benefits from strong backing by China Huaneng Group and strategic positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company has total assets of approximately RMB 214.6 billion and net assets attributable to shareholders of about RMB 73.6 billion. It achieved operating revenue of RMB 24.88 billion, an increase of 6.05% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 8.3 billion, up 8.63%. Installed capacity reached 31.01 million kW, with hydropower accounting for 27.31 million kW and new energy 3.7 million kW. The company shows steady growth in revenue, profit, and installed capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated, basin-wide, and rolling development model to maximize resource allocation in the Lancang River basin. It offers stable, clean, and reliable hydropower and renewable energy supply, supporting national energy security and low-carbon transition goals. Its advanced technology adoption, digital and AI-driven management platforms, and strong multi-energy complementary dispatch capabilities differentiate it as a modern, efficient, and sustainable green power provider.
